create_character_token_embedder: create a CharacterTokenEmbedder with a vocab, convolution filters, and highway layers for character-level word embeddings
build_highway_layer: build a Highway layer with configurable input dimension and number of layers for residual gating
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the CharacterTokenEmbedder to convert word indices into character-based embeddings
review_set_vocab: review the set_vocab method that converts vocabulary words into character index tensors for embedding lookup
test_convolutional_encoding: test the _convolve method that applies 1D convolutions and max pooling over character embeddings
